messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] calculateDiffMeth specify test
parts:
You can not specify the test. There are two tests available and which test is used depends on if you have multiple samples or not. You can force the function to apply Fisher's exact if you pool your samples. See section 6.8 of the vignette.

Best,
Altuna
